raw_blocks: Leading the Oil & Gas Industry in Execution Excellence

Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production. Our experience is unparalleled. Key managers have not only accumulated decades of knowledge in the industry but have also worked together as a team for an average of 25 years. As a company, our roots go back 50 years and three generations.
faster, safer and more productive solutions
Cactus™ SafeDrill ® Wellhead Systems

Cactus™ SafeDrill ® Wellhead Systems include a complete line of drill-through single piece multi-bowl wellhead systems that enhance field personnel safety and save valuable rig time. These efficient and innovative systems, with a straight bore design and lock ring technology, are safer, easier and faster to install than conventional wellhead systems and maximize the benefits of pad drilling.
Discover Cactus™ SafeDrill ® Wellhead Systems
Cactus Wellhead™ has the quality products and the experienced service technicians to assure that your frac job will be completed without surprises.
Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production.

Cactus Wellhead™ products and systems are designed and manufactured to the highest industry standards. We have implemented a fully documented API Spec 6A and Q1/ISO 9001:2015 quality management system that supports our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities. Hands-on involvement and communication by branch operations, installation crews and manufacturing facilities ensure that Cactus Wellhead™ is fully committed to quality excellence and reduction of risk.
ENSURING PERSONNEL, ASSET & COMMUNITY PROTECTION

Cactus Wellhead™, through a formal and comprehensive company-wide HSE management program, fulfills its commitment for the well-being and protection of individuals at all field and company locations. We establish and adhere to our own strict safety standards as well as those of our valued customers.

pages.raw_meta: Cactus™’ roots in the oilfield reach back three generations to 1957. We strive to gain our customers' trust, deliver reliable products and constantly promote value.
raw_blocks: Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production.

Guided by a relentless focus on customer service and the conviction that their resulting loyalty will maximize owner value, we will strive for operational excellence in all dealings with our clients, associates, and suppliers. We will consistently outperform our peers by refusing to compromise on safety, honesty, and professionalism.

Our experience is unparalleled. Key managers have not only accumulated decades of knowledge in the industry but have also worked together as a team for an average of 25 years. As a company, our roots go back 50 years and three generations. We are well known and trusted by the industry for our integrity, responsiveness and problem-solving capabilities. Customer responses to our post-job completion surveys confirm their satisfaction with and confidence in their continuing relationship with Cactus™.

In order to provide the best and most reliable results for our customers, we engage the industry’s most experienced engineers, manufacture in Cactus™ owned facilities and incorporate stringent quality and safety standards. Our strategically located branch operation centers are manned by associates who focus on partnering with our customers.

We have a horizontal corporate structure which makes us flexible and responsive to our customers’ needs. Our internal communications allow us to make efficient decisions, based on trust and established procedures.
View our corporate press releases.

“Cactus Wellhead™ is committed to providing outstanding customer service through compliance and continual improvement in the quality of our processes and services and always striving to exceed our customers’ expectations in every way.”
